title: Does the Sycophancy Activation Signature Transfer Across Instruction-Tuning Variants?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful for monitoring scalability: if probes must be retrained per checkpoint, this significantly increases monitoring overhead. The practical implication is clear but narrow to labs doing frequent model updates.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running the SAE + probe pipeline on multiple fine-tuning variants of the same base model. Finding differently fine-tuned Gemma-2 checkpoints and running activation probes on each is expert-level work.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Requires finding or creating multiple fine-tuning variants, running the full probe pipeline on each, and computing cross-variant statistics. The checkpoint acquisition alone is a significant scope issue.
